title: Analyzing Right-wing YouTube Channels: Hate, Violence and Discrimination
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study focused on detecting and analyzing hate speech, violence, and discriminatory bias (against immigrants, LGBT individuals, and Muslims) within YouTube video captions and comments. It utilizes NLP techniques like word embeddings (Word2Vec) and topic modeling (LDA), which predate the modern Large Language Model (LLM) era. While it analyzes bias against a religious group (Muslims), it focuses on social discrimination and hate speech rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious theology, faith, morals, or ethics.
